review_source: Actual independent collaboration-subtask code inspection and bounded offline checks, not a human review or execution grant.
reviewed_scope: Historical read-only candidate adoption, native graph/source/controller replay, full inherited version projection, NONE rehearsal publication subtype and switch/recovery boundary.
resolved_review_findings: Historical owner/request/controller reconstruction no longer relies on live/current code authorization.
B01 is bound to the original stage run id and exact CompanyFacts source.
Isolated active roots are accepted only under their own marker; actual repository roots remain forbidden.
Runtime and historical authority are bound to exact code/file identities.
Bundle verification does not execute Python from the bundle; trusted scanners recompute results from its data bytes.
New manifest id fields are registered and cold implementation_tree is verified.
Historical response reading no longer creates empty controller directories.
Recovery validates the approved edge without requiring already-repaired mirrors.
limitations: Independent negative copies were removed and original bundles were unchanged. The reviewer did not change any active pointer.
The parent agent is executing the complete fault-injection, hard-crash, rollback/restore and remaining tamper suite; this review does not claim those full tests were independently rerun.
This review does not activate the proposed adoption policy or authorize a real R3 publication/switch.
